category_title: Energetic child with autism using AAC and exhibiting behavioral protests
scenario_title: Managing behavioral protests during transition to horse riding
minimal_context: Adam is in the lounge and needs to transition to his horse riding activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Adam, it is 10:05am. It is time to transition to horse riding.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits on the floor in the lounge, seeming to have decided that he didn't want to go.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to go to horse riding now. Please stand up.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains on the floor, showing his clear and strong views about not wanting to do the activity.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Spits when the teacher comes near him to enforce the transition.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Adam, it is 10:05am. It is time to transition to horse riding.

STUDENT: (Sits on the floor in the lounge, seeming to have decided that he didn't want to go.)

TUTOR: We need to go to horse riding now. Please stand up.

STUDENT: (Remains on the floor, showing his clear and strong views about not wanting to do the activity.)

TUTOR: Come on, Adam, let's go.

STUDENT: (Spits when the teacher comes near him to enforce the transition.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When it was time to transition to horse riding and his teacher came near him
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Sat on the floor in the lounge and spat when his teacher came near him
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Seemed to have decided that he didn't want to go; clear and often strong views about how he wanted to spend his time

behavior_patterns.condition: When attempting to re-engage after a period of dysregulation
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Looked at what his teacher was doing, moved closer, and held out his hand towards his teacher

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked if he wanted more massage or was finished
